settings.headline: 48 hours. No, really.
settings.text: The new PulseMax Pro uses our most efficient chip yet — the M4 Neural Engine — combined with an industry-first solid-state battery. That's a full work week of listening on a single charge. And when you do need to charge, 10 minutes gets you 5 more hours.

reviews.name: The Verge
reviews.text: The PulseMax Pro doesn't just compete with the best — it redefines what personal audio should sound like. The spatial audio implementation is the most convincing we've ever tested.

reviews.name: MKBHD
reviews.text: This is the one. After testing literally hundreds of headphones, the PulseMax Pro is what I reach for every single day. The battery life alone is worth the price of admission.

reviews.name: Ankit M.
reviews.text: Coming from AirPods Max, I was skeptical. But the sound staging on this is on another level. The noise cancellation in the Delhi metro is genuinely magical. Best Rs. 25K I've spent.

items.question: How does Spatial Audio work?
items.answer: PulseMax Pro uses gyroscope and accelerometer data combined with mathematical modeling to create a virtual 3D sound field around your head. As you move, the sound stage stays fixed in space — creating the illusion of being inside a recording studio or concert hall.

items.question: Is 48-hour battery realistic?
items.answer: Yes. Tested with ANC on, at moderate listening volume (50%). With ANC off and lower volume, battery can extend beyond 60 hours. Fast charge gives you 5 hours from just 10 minutes of charging via USB-C.

items.question: Can I use them for calls?
items.answer: Absolutely. The 6-mic beamforming array with AI noise isolation means your voice comes through crystal clear — even in noisy environments like coffee shops, trains, or open offices.
